classification: Prospective synthetic message-context comparison; not legal certification.

premises.purpose: A hospital exports a synthetic statistics dataset to an external analytics team. The export job's intended handling and completion label are carried in the message export_context. Evaluate the observed message, not the label alone.
premises.permission_details: This export relies on the Safe Harbor de-identification path declared in the message. No expert-determination path is claimed. Assess whether the observed output contradicts that declared path, not whether a different legal permission could apply.
premises.safeguards: Only synthetic messages are used. The external statistics team is the intended recipient. No real patient information is included.
premises.exceptions: This check concerns consistency of the detected fields and date precision with the declared Safe Harbor path. It does not certify every identifier category, age handling, actual knowledge of re-identification, or overall disclosure permission.
premises.recipient_mapping: M5Source and ProcessB are internal transport. ReceiverB represents the stated external statistics team within this simulation.
premises.data_scope: The captured message body is the export output for this synthetic statistics task. Both cases have identical task context and business premises; only output fields differ.
